title: the credit notes API

reasons.graphql: GraphQL plumbing: the shared authentication and permission examples (requires current user/organization/permission) and the GraphQL type definitions. Tanvo serves Connect RPCs; authentication and dashboard permissions are libs/auth's, tested there, and the response shape is the proto of libs/proto. The API key permission examples are ported (TestCreditNotePermissions).
reasons.n-plus-one: N+1 query detection of ActiveRecord includes, which has no counterpart: the store loads a page's items and applied taxes with one query each (libs/store creditNoteLoad) and the metadata with the credit note row; there is no lazy association loading.
reasons.one-api: Kept deviation: one RPC, DownloadCreditNote, serves the REST and dashboard clients and follows the REST controller (credit_notes_controller.rb download_pdf and download_xml: enqueue the document job, answer empty, then return the links), where the dashboard mutation renders the document at once (mutations/credit_notes/download.rb). The invoice download does the same (docs/parity.md, Download PDF and XML).
reasons.provider: Needs a tax provider refusing the report. The refusal is ported at the service, which keeps it as a tax error and returns the error (libs/billing/creditnotes/refund_test.go, report_service_spec.rb:141); the RPC maps it like every service error.
reasons.attributed-feature-flag: The account_tree feature flag of the attributed usage endpoint: Tanvo has no feature flags (parity §1.50); an organization whose events are not in the ClickHouse store gets the same PermissionDenied feature_unavailable (TestGetAttributedUsageUnavailable).

notes: The REST and GraphQL credit note endpoints are one Connect service, `CreditNoteService` (creditnotes.go), over libs/billing/creditnotes; the cases are ported against its REST transcoding in creditnotes_test.go and creditnotes_view_test.go. The resend mutation is ported through the document service behind `ResendCreditNote` (apps/server/internal/app/creditnote_resend_test.go).

The index cases of `spec/support/shared_examples/credit_note_index.rb` (billing entity codes, :332 and :350) are not `_spec.rb` files; they are ported in TestListCreditNoteFilters citing `credit_note_index.rb:8-9`.
